answer: Audits are entered in tundra, queued in bridge, and comet publishes the wait time. A farm of 222 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 51 identities per epoch. A farm of 3199 identities would post 3054 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
